scenes.vo: 1952. A country writes to one man, and offers him the job of president. He says no.
Israel's first president had just died. They wanted this man next, and he was not even a politician.
Decades earlier, he checked inventions in a patent office, and in his spare time, he rewrote physics. He was twenty-six.
His most famous idea fits into five characters. Mass and energy, two sides of the same thing.
He was seventy-three. So why say no? He wrote back that he lacked the experience to deal properly with people.
